say:2:1120737001:0.female: Magister, you've returned. Have you found a Mauler candidate for the Bestial Brawl?

choice_prompt:3:1120737001.text: Magister, you've returned. Have you found a Mauler candidate for the Bestial Brawl?
choice_prompt:3:1120737001.source_cn: 魔法师<male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，你回来了？有找到愿意参加斗兽演祀的蛮血吗？
choice_prompt:3:1120737001.male: Magister, you've returned. Have you found a Mauler candidate for the Bestial Brawl?
choice_prompt:3:1120737001.female: Magister, you've returned. Have you found a Mauler candidate for the Bestial Brawl?

say:5:1120737005:0.text: Please hear us out! The magister has good reason to nominate him!
say:5:1120737005:0.source_cn: 您、您别激动！主人看重他是有理由的！
say:5:1120737005:0.male: Please hear us out! The magister has good reason to nominate him!
say:5:1120737005:0.female: Please hear us out! The magister has good reason to nominate him!

say:6:1120737006:0.text: The Claw we've found is an incredible warrior! The Bestial Brawl would be a breeze for him!
say:6:1120737006:0.source_cn: 那个流沙之爪有优秀的滑沙技巧，肯定能轻松完成斗兽演祀！

say:7:1120737007:0.text: Absolutely not! Among the clans of the Crimson Highlands, countless Maulers have disappeared, all thanks to the Quicksand Claws and Adamant Syndicate!
say:7:1120737007:0.source_cn: 不，不行……绝对不行！深红高原这些部族里，那么多青壮年...

say:8:1120737008:0.text: Even if we forgo the Bestial Brawl and face the wrath of the Dusk Lord, we shall never forgive this band of villains for our fallen brethren!
say:8:1120737008:0.source_cn: 哪怕斗兽演祀无法举行，不得不遭受残阳神的怒火……我们也...

say:9:1120737009:0.text: I spit on these sons of goats! I'll never accept the Quicksand Claws!
say:9:1120737009:0.source_cn: 只有流沙之爪……我无论如何都不会接受！

say:11:1120737002:0.text: That's excellent! But why didn't the warrior accompany you here?
say:11:1120737002:0.source_cn: 那太好了哟！但那位勇士……没跟着您一起过来吗？
say:11:1120737002:0.male: That's excellent! But why didn't the warrior accompany you here?
say:11:1120737002:0.female: That's excellent! But why didn't the warrior accompany you here?

say:12:1120737003:0.text: Honorable elder, the candidate we have found is... well... a Quicksand Claw.
say:12:1120737003:0.source_cn: 族长爷爷，我们找到的那个人……是个流沙之爪。

choice:3:1:2.text: Can you take a Quicksand Claw?
choice:3:1:2.male: Can you take a Quicksand Claw?
choice:3:1:2.female: Can you take a Quicksand Claw?
